title: Tailwind CSS Plugin options
description: Defines configuration used by the "tailwindcss-plugin" Heft task event.

compiler.description: The compile tool to use. "cli" uses @tailwindcss/cli, "postcss" uses postcss + @tailwindcss/postcss.

postcssPluginOptions.description: Options passed to the @tailwindcss/postcss plugin. Only used when compiler is "postcss".
